say:0:1360011001:2.text: After meeting up with Chippy, you head to the Ashen Wastes to visit Brutus.
say:0:1360011001:2.source_cn: 与去而复返的满满会合后，你们一道前往荒角沙漠，去拜访布...

say:4:1360011002:0.text: Ah, welcome, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've come to join the Emberlight Duel, I assume?
say:4:1360011002:0.male: Ah, welcome, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've come to join the Emberlight Duel, I assume?
say:4:1360011002:0.female: Ah, welcome, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You've come to join the Emberlight Duel, I assume?

say:5:1360011003:0.text: What's the Emberlight Duel? Is it a tournament?
say:5:1360011003:0.source_cn: ……春焰比武？是春焰庆的比武吗？

say:6:1360011004:0.text: Yes, it is a tournament held during the Emberlight Festival, where warriors from all corners are invited to battle freely on the arena stage.
say:6:1360011004:0.source_cn: 没错，在春焰庆期间，我们会选拔出各路好手，在擂台上尽情比斗。

say:7:1360011005:0.text: Damian was right. Other places have people dressing up as monsters, but the Maulers don't bother with that tradition...
say:7:1360011005:0.source_cn: 呃，和达米安说的一样，别处都是扮成怪兽，只有蛮血这边完...

say:8:1360011006:0.text: We believe that external decoration is unnecessary—true emotions are best expressed through the clash of steel and the intensity of battle.
say:8:1360011006:0.source_cn: 我们认为外表的装饰是无用之物，想要表达的情感用战斗便足...

say:9:1360011007:0.text: Consider the Fall Harvest. While others may adorn themselves, we honor the harvest by mimicking the combat styles of the Lightbearers and the Wildlings. It is our way of showing gratitude—through strength.
say:9:1360011007:0.source_cn: 就像是秋夜节，我们也会模仿耀光或者绿裔的战斗方式，来表...

say:10:1360011008:0.text: Other places use costumes, but here you change up your combat techniques...
say:10:1360011008:0.source_cn: 别处是变装，你们这里是更换战技啊……

say:11:1360011009:0.text: And what about the Winter Carnival? Wait, Chippy can guess what you're about to say...

say:12:1360011010:0.text: As for the Winter Carnival, while it may not snow in the desert, we still hold dances to celebrate. Young and old, they join together to express their emotions and strengthen their bonds.
say:12:1360011010:0.source_cn: 虽说是隆冬节，但沙漠并不会下雪。不过同样会举行欢庆舞会...

say:14:1360011011:0.text: But mark my words—before one can dance, one must prove their strength. Only then is grace earned.
say:14:1360011011:0.source_cn: 但！想要翩翩起舞，就必须先展现自己的力量，才能获得资格！

choice_prompt:15:1360011011.text: But mark my words—before one can dance, one must prove their strength. Only then is grace earned.
choice_prompt:15:1360011011.source_cn: 但！想要翩翩起舞，就必须先展现自己的力量，才能获得资格！

say:16:1360011012:0.text: Hah, battle speaks clearer than any words. It is the language of the soul!
say:16:1360011012:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，没错！用战斗来交谈，比任何语言都更快！

say:17:1360011013:0.text: I still think using our words to express emotions would be clearer...
say:17:1360011013:0.source_cn: 我是觉得我们的目的用语言表达会更清晰……

say:18:1360011014:1.text: Now, friends, enough talk. Let us not hesitate—let us test our strength in the arena to honor the coming Emberlight Festival!
say:18:1360011014:1.source_cn: 来吧，朋友们，不要客气，为了庆祝即将到来的春焰庆，来一场吧！
